senses.gloss: m. (denom. of קֶרֶן) providing with horns; trnsf. horned animal.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Menahot 13:6">Tosef. Men. XIII, 6</cite> <he>הרי עלי ק׳ והביא גמום וכ׳</he> (not <he>הביא נימוס</he>) if one says, I vow a sacrifice of a horned animal, and brings one whose horns are levelled, or I vow a hornless animal, and brings a horned one (v. <cite ref="C01054"><he>גָּמַם</he></cite>).—[<he>קירונין</he>, <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 4">Lam. R. to IV, 15</cite> some ed., v. <cite ref="S01951"><he>קָרוֹן</he></cite>, a. <cite ref="S01943"><he>קָרוּכִין</he></cite>.]
